messages:
maria: heads-up — ran a purge (multi-select) and found rows from a different org were deleted. repro on prod-canary after the new multi-select refactor.

chris: yikes. which deploy rolled the refactor?

deploy-bot: deploy: frontend/multi-select 2026-03-19T07:30Z canary -> prod-c

maria: repro steps: org 58 view, select across pages using the sticky selection, run purge -> server returns success and count includes org 60 rows.

sam: can you paste request payload? curious whether client sent cross-org ids or server stripped header.

maria: payload snippet:
POST /api/v1/purge
headers: { Authorization: Bearer ***, X-Org-ID: 58 }
body: { ids: ["row:58:900","row:60:402"], confirm: true }
response: 200 { deleted: 2 }

lela: looks like selection store kept ids from previous org. UI key is `sticky_selection_v3` and has no org scoping. quick-switch doesn't clear.

chris: server-side rule: we should never honor ids that don't match X-Org-ID. add a guard that validates and returns 422 with code `ORG_MISMATCH`. ship that first.

sam: +1. also emit metric `purge_org_mismatch_total` and log a sample of mismatches for debugging (scrub PII).

maria: I've opened a short repro script for QA and CS.

ops-bot: query-start: SELECT count(*) FROM purge_events WHERE affected_org != caller_org AND timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours'; id=Q-11000
ops-bot: query-done: rows=2 id=Q-11000

chris: two events in 24h. rollback the canary while we patch.

deploy-bot: action: rollback frontend/multi-select canary -> previous at 2026-03-19T07:25Z initiated by chris
deploy-bot: rollback-complete: succeeded

lela: UI fix: prefix selection key with org id, and show toast "Selection cleared after org switch" with CTA to recover if user initiated the change. also migrate existing keys by clearing ambiguous ones on next load.

sam: long term we should move sticky selection into sessionStorage scoped per route. filing RFC and adding test plan.

maria: owners: chris (server), lela (frontend), sam (design/rfc), maria (CS). ETA for server patch: 1.5h.

chris: I'll open the server PR now with unit+integration tests. will include metric and error code.

maria: adding incident stub: cause=global selection persisted across org-switch; impact=purge/delete across orgs; mitigation=rollback + server validation; owners=[chris, lela]; due=tomorrow. closing loop when server patch is live. :thumbsup:
